messages:
Mia (PM): Quick heads-up — we need to re-evaluate MVP vs v1 for the Embeddings Cache slice. Customer X requested tenant SSO + enterprise observability, but infra bandwidth + a quantization slip are putting the current timeline at risk. Proposal: ship Embeddings Cache + basic console telemetry in MVP (NA canary), postpone tenant-level SSO and full enterprise onboarding to v1. Thoughts? :thinking:

Raj (Eng-Platform): +1 in principle. Tenant SSO is a fairly large infra lift (SCIM, cert rotation, prod networking, audit hooks) — likely 3 sprints if we do it properly. Shipping it now will blow schedule. What do we consider the acceptable signup/onboarding risk for pilots?

Elena (Design): Removing SSO will change the onboarding flow for enterprise pilots. Suggest labeling the MVP as "Enterprise Preview" and presenting a clear CTA to request pilot access. We can ship a temporary modal and dedicated support path rather than blocking launch.

Sam (Eng-ML): Heads up: model quantization work is slipping ~2w, which increases per-token cost in the MVP profile. Embeddings Cache helps, but we should set conservative cache TTLs and clear metrics. Can we scope cache to 30d TTL + LRU eviction for MVP?

DeployBot: Milestone updated — "Embeddings Cache MVP (NA canary)" assigned to product@redwood; target date 2026-04-15.

Mia (PM): OK — proposed immediate actions:
- Raj: open infra spike + JIRA tickets for cache and canary infra
- Sam: define TTL/eviction/measurement and add to dashboard
- Elena: draft enterprise preview copy and onboarding fallback
If we agree, I'll update the roadmap and move SSO to v1. Need sign-off by EOD Thu. :calendar:

Raj (Eng-Platform): I'll open the tickets. Minimal acceptance criteria I propose (for MVP canary):
- Cache write success rate > 99% under synthetic load
- Cache hit rate >= 20% within 30d on our benchmark trace
- End-to-end median latency delta <= +20ms
I'll post ENG-PLAT-452 and ENG-PLAT-453 in the thread.

Elena (Design): Draft copy snippet for product UI:
"Enterprise Preview: Tenant SSO and dedicated onboarding are available by request for pilot customers. Contact your account lead to enable."
I'll put this in figma and share the link.

Sam (Eng-ML): Confirmed: TTL = 30d, eviction = LRU for MVP. Metrics to emit: cache_hit_ratio, cache_write_errors, avg_insert_time. I'll wire them into the existing embeddings dashboard and add a cost estimate table for the canary.

Mia (PM): Thanks all — I'll update the public roadmap, add the canary note, and ping sales/support. :thumbsup:

Raj (Eng-Platform): +1. One more risk: if quantization isn't ready by canary, attach the cost estimator to every PR that changes model path so we can make live decisions quickly.

Mia (PM): Good call — adding that as a required PR checklist item. End-to-end plan looks set.

(emoji reactions: :thumbsup: from Raj, Elena; :rocket: from Sam)
